mapper.select: SELECT id, created_by_user_id AS createdByUserId, group_id AS groupId, name, link_code AS linkCode, code_type AS codeType, full_url AS fullUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder, short_domain_id AS shortDomainId, expires_at AS expiresAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, created_at AS createdAt FROM t_link WHERE created_by_user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: WITH requested_group AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT CAST(#{link.groupId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) AS id ), eligible_group AS ( SELECT candidate.id FROM t_group candidate JOIN requested_group requested ON candidate.id = requested.id WHERE candidate.user_id = #{link.createdByUserId} AND candidate.deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE OF candidate ) INSERT INTO t_link (id, created_by_user_id, group_id, name, link_code, code_type, full_url, sort_order, short_domain_id, expires_at, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{link.id}, #{link.createdByUserId}, requested.id, #{link.name}, #{link.linkCode}, #{link.codeType}, #{link.fullUrl}, #{link.sortOrder}, #{link.shortDomainId}, #{link.expiresAt}, #{link.idempotencyKey}, #{link.requestFingerprint}, #{link.createdAt}, #{link.createdAt} FROM requested_group requested WHERE requested.id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible_group) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
